handoff.resume.user_pending: Last turn is an unanswered user request -> immediately answer and execute it.
handoff.resume.mid_task: Interrupted mid-task during tool execution -> continue from the interruption point and verify; do not redo finished steps.
handoff.resume.awaiting_user: Predecessor proposed a plan or question awaiting the user's decision -> briefly restate it and ask; do not act on anything not yet approved.
handoff.resume.completed_idle: Previous turn completed cleanly -> briefly confirm you have taken over and wait for new instructions.
quote.label: Replying to
branch.truncated: …({n} more lines cut; see the branch session)
fork.dropped: > {n} more items were left out to stay under {cap} tokens; look them up through the transcript pointer when needed.
fork.no_goal: (not given yet; the user will state it in the branch)
fork.title: # ⑂ Clean branch anchor (distilled clean fork)
fork.transcript: - Parent transcript: `{path}` (grep it by keyword for details; don't reread it whole)
fork.context: - The parent context is about {tokens} tokens; this branch does not inherit it and starts from 0k
fork.rules: - Rules: work only on the branch goal below; this file is the source of truth for the main line; when done, write a conclusion of at most 10 lines to merge back.
fork.native_rule: work only on the branch goal below; the main line's history is for reference
fork.boot: This is a clean branch of session {sid} (0k context, the main line's history is not inherited). Read the anchor file {path} in full first, then work only on its branch goal.
hold.card: ⏸ "{title}" finished its turn ({prev}→{new}); {n} messages were held meanwhile:

hold.choices: ➡ inject_main: send them to the main line as one message ｜ fork_branch: handle them in a clean branch
hold.fork: [⏸ {n} messages held during the main line's turn, moved into this branch]
hold.stale: This routing card is out of date (new messages arrived or it was handled); wait for the next one.
session.pick_waiting: waiting for a session to be picked

update.manual: MixHub was installed with the system pip; upgrade it with: {cmd}
update.missing_tool: `{tool}` was not found, so MixHub can't update itself; install it or reinstall MixHub with install.sh
update.restarted: Restarted on the new version: {what}. Agent sessions kept running.
